entries.426a86f5741aa29d: Under the medium-term management plan 'CONNECT 2030' announced on April 8, 2026, the group states that it will implement measures aimed at continuing to put customers first and pursuing sustainable growth, co-creating new value with customers, and accelerating DX investment and strengthening its financial base, under the slogan 'KUTSUROGI' to connect people, communities and the world. As priority issues to address, it lists pursuing Komeda-style full service, accelerating store expansion with a focus on profitability, and strengthening in-house manufacturing to thoroughly ensure safety and security and improve productivity; it also aims to establish a system of more than 50 Okage-an stores through strengthened store openings, fully launch FC expansion in its overseas markets, and develop new countries mainly in ASEAN.

entries.a95637ecf352c784: Its strengths are its original store format that prioritizes relaxation, and its original FC system, which maintains the motivation of FC franchisee operators through a fixed-fee royalty proportional to the number of seats and a highly flexible store operating policy.
